# Tales of UJ

> Theyyam & portrait photography by Ujual P S — storytelling through the lens.

## About

Tales of UJ is the photography and portfolio website of Ujual P S, a photographer and frontend engineer based in Kerala, India.

Ujual P S specialises in Theyyam photography — capturing the divine energy, elaborate costumes, and ritual intensity of the Theyyam art form, a traditional folk art of northern Kerala. He also does portrait photography focused on authentic emotion and visual storytelling.

Alongside photography, Ujual P S is a frontend engineer with expertise in React, Next.js, and modern web development. He is available for freelance work in both photography and software development.

## About Theyyam

Theyyam is a ritual art form native to the Malabar region of northern Kerala, India. Performers embody deities through elaborate makeup, costumes, and dance, often in nightlong ceremonies. Ujual P S documents Theyyam with a focus on preserving its cultural significance through photography.
